description: Redaction fails closed on what no conformance script can give, since the TypeScript codec refuses it, but raw host code in Rust can: an undeclared member of an argument, a record or an event, an event of an undeclared tag, an emitted event whose members fit no machine's declaration, a value of the wrong shape, and stale outcomes. Both cores must write `redact-malformed.jsonl` from these inputs (their trace records in order, canonical JSON, without t and run).
